notes: Version 2.4 corrects the status of four statements and of the companion gravity and gauge results. The homogeneous dimension 4 follows from the Bass-Guivarc'h formula for the discrete Heisenberg group with two horizontal generators; on the finite group it holds only for balls of radius n << sqrt(q); it is a property of the supplied carrier and is not identified with the 3+1 structure of spacetime. Complex amplitudes enter with the spinor carrier supplied conditionally by O23: coherence excludes a classical probability mixture but not real amplitudes, and real and quaternionic formulations are compared with their composition rules (Stueckelberg 1960, Renou et al. 2021, Barrios Hita et al. 2026, Adler 1995); a selection from the axioms is open. Projective incompleteness does not guarantee the initial transition (Remark 4.11). The Einstein, Yang-Mills and Einstein-Yang-Mills statements of Gravity, Q12 and Q13 are stated with their hypotheses: a supplied metric and compact gauge group, couplings as matching data, a Euclidean derivation; no coupling hierarchy is derived. Bibliography entries of cited corpus papers are synchronised with the programme registry. No Foundation theorem is changed.
